create_rapid_ocr_model: create a RapidOcrModel instance with RapidOcrOptions and AcceleratorOptions for OCR on PDF pages
run_ocr_on_pages: run RapidOcrModel on a batch of Page objects to extract text cells with bounding boxes and confidence scores
get_ocr_rects: get OCR detection rectangles for a Page to determine regions where text should be extracted
post_process_cells: post-process extracted OCR text cells on a Page to clean and organize the results
get_options_type: get the RapidOcrOptions type class from RapidOcrModel via the get_options_type class method
